summary: The kubelet panics while loading/defaulting its configuration because PodLevelResourcesFixDefaulting is enabled while its dependency PodLevelResources is disabled. The process is restarted and panics again, so /configz becomes unavailable and the e2e test later reports a context deadline exceeded symptom.
evidence_markers: failed to merge global and in-flight KubeletConfiguration while setting defaults
leak_terms: failed to merge global and in-flight KubeletConfiguration while setting defaults
